mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Anthropic?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Anthropic release in this tracker is Claude Opus 5, released Jul 24, 2026. Anthropic's new flagship model, approaching Claude Fable 5-level intelligence at roughly half the price, now the default on Claude Max and the strongest option on Claude Pro. Includes a new effort dial letting users trade off cost and capability, plus stronger coding, agentic, and self-verification performance.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Google release in this tracker is Gemini 3.6 Flash, released Jul 21, 2026. Google's new workhorse model — cheaper and more efficient than its predecessor, with fewer wasted reasoning steps and tool calls on coding and multi-step tasks. Available now in the Gemini app, API, Google Antigravity, and enterprise platforms.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from OpenAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest OpenAI release in this tracker is ChatGPT Work, released Jul 9, 2026. A new ChatGPT agent, powered by GPT-5.6, that pulls context from a team's apps, files, and workflows to independently produce finished documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and reports, working continuously on complex projects for hours at a time.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Meta?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Meta release in this tracker is Llama 5, released Apr 8, 2026. Meta's newest open-source flagship model, featuring over 600 billion parameters and 'Recursive Self-Improvement' capabilities that let it refine its own reasoning and generate synthetic training data. Designed for complex multi-step problems that previously required human oversight.
